summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on integration work with Spark, including updates on Spark 4.1 and 4.2 features. Additionally, proposals for fine-grained read restrictions and improvements to the v4 specification have been highlighted, alongside ongoing discussions about documentation issues and support for repartitioning old partition specification data files.
highlights: Iceberg Spark Community Sync notes on integration work and updates
Proposal for finer grained read restrictions in loadTable response
Discussion on duplicated search results in Iceberg documentation
Support for repartitioning old partition spec data files
